_comment: Website-wide announcements shown in Notifications. Add new entries at the top. Fields: id (unique, never reuse), type (feature | update | announcement | important), title, description (1-2 short sentences), created_at (ISO date/time), optional route (app page to open, e.g. "settings").

announcements.title: Notifications inbox
announcements.description: Website updates now appear here. Unread items are marked with a dot.

announcements.title: Interactive setup guide
announcements.description: The setup guide now highlights the exact button to click on each page. Restart it any time from Settings.

announcements.title: Explanations for your numbers
announcements.description: Hover or tap a dashboard value to see what it means and where it comes from.

announcements.title: Saved budgets moved into a dialog
announcements.description: Use “Load Saved Budgets” on the Budget page to open, preview and load your saved plans.
